expert.text: Over 40% of agentic AI projects will be canceled by the end of 2027
About 20% of respondents have scaled AI agents across their organization; among firms with over $1 billion revenue the share is 40%.

history.note: Placed when the radar moved to stable megatrends

lens.cio: Choose three workflows to redesign end to end, with clear success and rollback criteria.
lens.ciso: Give every agent its own identity, least privilege and an audit trail before it reaches production.
lens.cto: Pick one agent platform and the open standards MCP and A2A now, before teams build incompatible ones.
lens.eng: Build agents on MCP and A2A, with tests, sandboxing and human approval for irreversible steps.

line: Firms are moving AI agents from pilots into daily work. Few have the controls to match.
scope: Agents doing enterprise work, and their platforms. Not shopping agents, agent security or raw capability.

title: Agentic AI & multiagent systems
why: 40% of large firms now scale agents, up from 27% a year ago.
Only 5% of firms have a full set of agent safeguards.
The open agent standards MCP and A2A now share one neutral foundation.
